subject.title: fix: active-memory recall fails with billing rejections on subscription-only Claude CLI setups

question: Should embedded helper dispatch be accepted as a core `claude-cli` special case, or moved to a generic CLI-backend capability before merge?
rationale: The choice establishes a permanent auth-routing and MCP-authorization boundary shared by agents, gateway code, and provider-owned runtime behavior.

options.title: Use backend capability
options.body: Move subscription-safe dispatch eligibility into the registered CLI backend contract and keep the embedded runner provider-agnostic.

options.title: Accept scoped special case
options.body: Keep the core `claude-cli` check with explicit agents and gateway owner approval and focused compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Use backend capability
recommendation.body: Move subscription-safe dispatch eligibility into the registered CLI backend contract and keep the embedded runner provider-agnostic.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor to both active-memory behavior and adjacent agent-runtime work.
